def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    fits = bins >= item
    remainder = bins % item
    return np.where(fits, -remainder, -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    fit_mask = bins >= item
    num_fit = np.floor(bins / item)
    remainder = bins % item
    scores = - (num_fit * remainder)
    return np.where(fit_mask, scores, -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    fits = bins >= item
    remaining_space = bins - item
    # Avoid division by zero, which will produce inf leading to -inf score
    ratio = item / remaining_space
    deviation = np.abs(ratio - 2)
    return np.where(fits, -deviation, -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    scores[mask] = -(bins[mask] - item)
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    import numpy as np
    return np.where(bins >= item, -(bins - item), -np.inf)
